scope: Four public metamaterials resources checked for identity, access URL, provenance, and data modality. ‘Simulation’ means the released records are computationally generated; it does not claim experimental validation.

datasets.title: SUTD Polarized Reflection of Complex Metasurfaces (SUTD-PRCM)
datasets.evidence: The paper describes approximately 260,000 complex metasurface samples created from electromagnetic simulation.
datasets.use: Benchmarking forward or inverse-learning workflows; not experimental spectra.

datasets.title: The Diversity of Three-Dimensional Photonic Crystals database
datasets.evidence: The database indexes structures, photonic band gaps, and band structures versus filling fraction and dielectric contrast.
datasets.use: Explore calculated crystal geometries and photonic-bandgap maps.

datasets.title: Dynamic Shaping of Multi-Touch Stimuli by Programmable Acoustic Metamaterial
datasets.evidence: Zenodo labels this a July 2025 dataset containing raw experimental physical and perceptual evaluations.
datasets.use: Inspect raw experimental data for a programmable low-frequency vibrotactile acoustic metamaterial.

datasets.title: DiffMeta MIM metamaterial inverse-design dataset
datasets.evidence: The July 2024 Zenodo release supplies 60,000 MIM structure records with emissivity, reflectivity, and transmittance spectra; the linked repository identifies it as generated/training data.
datasets.use: Reproduce or benchmark manufacturing-aware inverse design of MIM optical metamaterials.
